2105-5895-7060-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-5895-7060-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-5895-7060-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Splash Portal from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Splash Portal from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Splash Portal, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

2099-4452-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
2099-4452-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability, giving Sarcatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

1339-1832-2034-7192.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1832-2034-7192.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}
When the Insect dies, Grave Venerations triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

1981-2403-2415-4247.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Moonlit Wake and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1315-2693-5721-6763.easyPrerequisites: Land cards in your graveyard and under your control can tap to add at least {4}{G}{B}.
1315-2693-5721-6763.description:
Activate each untapped land you control by tapping it, adding mana.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it.
In response, activate Zuran Orb repeatedly by sacrificing each land you control, gaining life each time.
Resolve the Aftermath Analyst ability, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Activate Phyrexian Reclamation by paying {1}{B} and 2 life, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G}.
Aftermath Analyst enters, triggering itself, causing you to mill three cards.

1368-2196-7437.easyPrerequisites:
You control up to three lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-2196-7437.description:
Activate up to three lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Frantic Search for its escape cost by paying {2}{U} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard.
Exhibition Tidecaller triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Resolve Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice and untap three lands.
Repeat.
1368-2196-7437.notes: Once you have milled your library, you may continue the combo using any remaining cards in your graveyard and target another player with Exhibition Tidecaller.

789-1263-2292-4871.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Gutter Grime trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 5 or greater

1494-6792-7748.description:
Deal combat damage using Ant-Man, triggering its ability, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enter, Mm'menon triggers that many times, putting at least five +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1880-3681--147.notablePrerequisites:
Hallar has a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to or greater than 9 minus the smallest number of poison counters an opponent has.
You have enough mana to cast the spell with kicker or multikicker, and there are legal target(s) for that spell, if applicable.
1880-3681--147.description:
Cast the spell with kicker or multikicker by paying its mana cost plus its kicker cost at least once.
Hallar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then causing each opponent to get a number of poison counters equal to its power.
Each opponent loses the game.
1880-3681--147.notes: Hallar's power can be lower if you happen to have multiple kicker and/or multikicker spells that you can cast.

1765-2292-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
1765-2292-5972.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Chishiro triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-4885-6441.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

104-851-5086-5183-5231.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
104-851-5086-5183-5231.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 1.

2173-2851-5220.description:
Activate Death Cultist by sacrificing it.
When Death Cultist dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Death Cultist from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Death Cultist ability, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Death Cultist from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

4-4200-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {2}{W}{W}.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0} and tapping Appa and another creature you control.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

2011-2060-6599.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Maester Seymour triggers, putting at least five +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability five times by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.

2872-4613-6210.easyPrerequisites:
Neerdiv has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Neerdiv, Devious Diver does not have summoning sickness.
2872-4613-6210.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that does not have summoning sickness and that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2872-4613-6210.description:
Activate a creature using Clever Conjurer's ability by tapping it, untapping Neerdiv.
Activate Neerdiv using Clever Conjurer's ability by tapping it.
Neerdiv triggers, causing a player to mill cards equal to its power.
Resolve the Neerdiv ability from step 2, untapping another creature.
Repeat.

2034-3490-5445.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two creatures.
Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached to any creature you control.
2034-3490-5445.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing any creature except the one with Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature it is attached to.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

283-509-2585.notablePrerequisites:
Idris does not have summoning sickness.
Illusionist's Bracers attached to Idris.
283-509-2585.description:
Activate Idris using Grim Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Idris using Grim Monolith's second ability by paying {4}.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Idris' ability.
Resolve the copy of Idris' ability, untapping it.
Activate Idris using Grim Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Idris ability from step 2, untapping it.
Repeat.

2436-3537-3746-4170.notablePrerequisites:
Robaran Mercenaries does not have summoning sickness.
Robaran Mercenaries has power 5 or greater.
2436-3537-3746-4170.description:
Activate Robaran Mercenaries using Marwyn's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Bog Initiate by paying {1}, adding {B}.
Activate Robaran Mercenaries using Fain's fourth ability by paying {3}{B}, untapping Robaran Mercenaries.
Repeat.

1323-3990-5137.notablePrerequisites: Experiment Kraj does not have summoning sickness.
1323-3990-5137.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Morphling.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Morphling's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Activate Experiment Kraj by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Incubation Druid.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Morphling's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Incubation Druid's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

requires.n: Soul Sister (Gain life when a creature enters)
